Place the votive into your snug-fitting glass holder, and trim the cotton wick to 1/4" before your first light.
Burn it for a few hours so the wax melts completely to the edges of the holder. When it gets down to the last 1/2", let it burn until it goes out on its own—this ensures all the wax is used up cleanly.
